description: FIX-PLAN Item 33a seam, OUT direction. Emitted by presentations (scripts/ghl_ops.py) at install and at delivery into working/ghl/ghl-ops-request.json. It lists the GoHighLevel operations a presentation run needs, each with the Wiring Gate verification expectations (the named read-back checks) the receipt must answer. Execution belongs to Skill 44 (44-convert-and-flow-operator) under its own gates; presentations never calls the GHL API for these operations and never impersonates the execution. Runtime enforcement lives in ghl_ops.validate_request (fail-closed at write time); this file is the contract document other tools validate against.

emitted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this emission.

executor.description: Who executes the request and under what rules. Specified, not impersonated: this block names Skill 44's own operator surface and gates; nothing on the presentations side performs these operations.

absent_fallback.description: What happens when Skill 44 is not available: today's behavior unchanged, the receipt recorded absent because Skill 44 was not available, and no operation marked done.

access_tiers.description: The Skill 36 tier chain the executor may use; the tier actually used is recorded on the receipt.

rate_limit.description: The shared GHL rate-limit bucket this work draws on (Skill 36 routing law: one bucket, all tiers).

surface.description: Skill 44's execution surface and gates (caf, PLAN MODE, dry-run first, draft-only default, location whitelist, approval gate, per-build QC), stated in words.

gates.description: The election gate decisions the operations derive from (the builders' own resolvers), recorded so a reader can see why a family is present or absent.

input_hashes.description: sha256 of the run inputs the request derives from (intake plus any per-phase contract artifacts present), keyed by run-relative path. A receipt answering different inputs is stale by construction.

notes.description: Honest omissions, in words: each operation family NOT requested, and why (election deferred or waived, approved-URL reuse, no booking calendar named). Silence about an omission is a defect.

operations.description: The requested operations. Non-empty: a run that needs nothing emits no request at all. Every operation names its verification expectations; an operation without expectations is refused at write time.

items.description: One GHL operation Skill 44 is asked to perform (or verify), with the Wiring Gate read-back checks its receipt entry must answer.

executor_notes.description: Execution guidance for the Skill 44 operator (idempotency, binding rules, draft posture), in words.

expect.description: The named verification read-back checks for this operation (the Wiring Gate, per object: the object exists in GHL, attached to the right funnel/page, triggers covered, a test submission landed, products and order forms bound and priced correctly). The receipt entry for this operation judges verified only when every check named here is present in its read-back with ok true.

kind.description: The operation kind: form.create_or_reuse, workflow.ensure_trigger_coverage, form.test_submission, product.create_or_reuse, order_form.bind_product, or calendar.verify_booking.

op_id.description: Stable operation id within the request; the receipt answers by this id.

spec.description: The operation's object spec, derived from the phase contract builders (never re-derived by the seam): names, field keys, trigger and steps, amounts and currency, embed rules.

target.description: Where a form must attach (page role, funnel, attach rule), when the operation has a placement target.

template_match_request.description: Optional. An elected follow-up template match request against Skill 44's automation template library. A request the executor's own matcher decides; never an instruction to build unmatched automations.

receipt_contract.description: Where the receipt lands and the rule it is judged by.

rule.description: The judging rule, stated on the request itself so the executor sees it before executing: an entry claiming success without its read-back is judged unverified, never success.

request_id.description: Unique id of this request emission (gxo_ plus 12 hex). The receipt must echo it exactly; a receipt answering another request_id is stale or foreign and judges invalid.

request_version.description: Monotonic version of the request within the run. Re-emission increments it; a receipt answering a superseded version judges invalid (stale).

scope.description: The run binding, resolved by ghl_external_installer.resolve_scope (the same binding the phase receipts use). The receipt must echo run_id, deck_slug, and the bound location_id.

source_contracts.description: The per-phase contract artifacts present in the run when the request was emitted, by run-relative path and sha256. The operations derive from these contracts' builders.

stage.description: install: emitted with the install run. delivery: re-emitted (new version) at delivery so the delivery record carries fresh verification of the same operations.

title: ghl-ops-request
